responsibility: Validates the dominators module against representative control-flow graphs, checking immediate-dominator assignment and dominance behavior for branching, cyclic, unreachable, and transitive-dominance cases.
same_name_distinction: Within the graph `tests.rs` files, this one is specifically about dominator-tree results, asserting immediate dominators and unreachable-node handling rather than traversal order, SCC condensation, or graph storage details.
